warning.titlePre: Land Rover Defender Td5 Injector & Crank Sensor Wear
paragraphs: If your Defender is a 1998–2007 model with the Td5 diesel five-cylinder — that's the classic 90/110/130 generation — injector and crank sensor wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by established Land Rover specialist consensus. We replace injectors, the head gasket, and cooling system components as standard on every Td5 rebuild.

The older 200Tdi and 300Tdi engines use a completely different mechanical injection system and don't share this specific issue — they have their own known wear patterns (cylinder head cracking and cooling system neglect), which we also cover in our classic Defender rebuilds.
warning.source: Source: established specialist consensus, multiple forums, per VRF-landrover-defender.md. 200Tdi/300Tdi have separate confirmed issues per VRF
